sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Vinay Kumar Singh,Shiv Sharan Lal Maurya
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1. Heard Sri Vinay Kumar Singh, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Amit Kumar Dwivedi,
learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the records.
2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
510 of 2022, under Sections 376, 506 I.P.C., registered at Police Station Safipur, District Unnao.

3.  The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 12.12.2022 alleging that when the informant was present at her field alone at about 11.00 a.m. on 04.12.2022 the applicant reached there, torn her cloths and raped her.

The informant told about the incident to her relatives,
whereafter they dialed number 112.
The police reached there but thereafter pressure was mounted on the informant to enter into a settlement.

4. In the statement of the victim recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C., she stated that after causing the incident the applicant left her at spot and ran away and after some time her mother reached on the Anoop vs State Of U.P. 5. In the medico legal examination report of the victim no mark of injury or sign of use of force has been reported.
6. In the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. she has stated that she is aged about 20 years.

sentences.text: She stated that the applicant lives outside the country.
She further stated that on the date of incident the applicant had shut her mouth with her dupatta, dragged her to a jungle and raped her twice.
Thereafter she returned to her field and her mother also came to the field and she told her about the incident.

7. In the affidavit filed in support of bail application it has been stated that the applicant is innocent,
he has been falsely implicated in the present case and he has no criminal history.
8. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

9. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the incident is alleged to have taken place on 04.12.2022 and the F.I.R. has been lodged on 12.12.2022; that in the F.I.R. and in the statement of the victim recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C.
she stated the place of occurrence to be a field, whereas in her statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C.
she stated that the occurrence took place in a jungle; that the F.I.R. states that after the incident, the victim told about it to her relatives, whereas in her statements under Section 161/164 Cr.P.C. she stated that her mother had reached the field and she had told about the incident to her mother coupled with the fact that the applicant has no previous criminal history and he is languishing in jail since 1612.2022 and without making any observation, which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail in the aforesaid crime.
10.
Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.

506 I.P.C., registered at Police Station Safipur, District Unnao on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of magistrate/court concerned, subject to following conditions:-
